title: Blue Seoul Vehicles
description: Blue Seoul Vehicles is a variety of civilian vehicle pack in South Korea
body:
![BLUE SEOUL VEHICLES v6 NARAE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f42ee7ebc46c923de531b47a36c57078437d0af.png)
Blue Seoul Vehicles is a content pack of Immersive Vehicles that adds realistic civilian vehicles in Korea.

**Blue Seoul Vehicles v6.1 Update**
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73827174af983cdf1c1353a4d0045a73487f75db_0.webp)
In this update, to celebrate 10K downloads, the existing Grandeur IG has been revamped, and the SantaFe TM and Universe with various colors have been newly added. Especially, it is available for Hyundai Universe to be customizable like County. We’d like to thank everyone who has waited patiently for so long, even though the update is still a work in progress. We look forward to seeing you again with the 6.2 update around July or August.




**Welcome to Seoul!**

You had just left from the airport express bus. What can you see? Fancy buildings? Namsan Tower over the skyline? Beneath those, you would get on the bus or taxi to reach station, hotel, and so on.
But what happened? Watching outside the window, you saw police cars, ambulance, and firetrucks going to somewhere rapidly.
You might feel nervous, but you would experience some great activities when you arrive to your destination! Have a nice trip!



This mod requires [Immersive Vehicles](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/minecraft-transport-simulator)

[Join Our Discord!](https://discord.com/invite/3WSUX5VNku)

This mod adds the following vehicles:

- HYUNDAI County 🚌
- HYUNDAI Universe Prime 🚌
- HYUNDAI Grand starex 🚚 🚑
- HYUNDAI Grandeur IG
- HYUNDAI Grandeur GN7
- HYUNDAI Santa Fe TM
- HYUNDAI Sonata New Rise 🚕 🚓
- HYUNDAI Sonata The Edge 🚓
- HYUNDAI Megatruck 🚚 🚒
- KIA K5 🚕 🚓
- KIA Ray
- HYUNDAI Elec City 🚌
- HYUNDAI New Super Aero City 🚌
- Higer Hypers 🚌
